_comment: Model-provenance debt, ratcheted. `ungated_loaders` are ml/ modules that call a model loader and reach no integrity check; `unlisted_artifacts` are committed model binaries no baseline records. Both lists may only SHRINK: scripts/model_provenance_report.py --check refuses a new entry in either. A file that leaves a list must be DELETED from it rather than left behind — an entry describing nothing is how a ratchet stops being one. Measured 2026-09-18 at 2 / 0, down from 12 / 7. UNLISTED ARTIFACTS is now empty. The seven committed binaries that no baseline mentioned were each hashed from the bytes on disk into the model_checksums.json of THEIR OWN DIRECTORY, which is the only file `_verify_checksum` reads for them (`path.parent / "model_checksums.json"`): ml/saved_models/GCF/ and ml/saved_models/XAU_USD/ (a random forest and a scaler each), ml/rl_models/ (nuclear_decision_ppo.zip and nuclear_decision_vecnorm.pkl) and ml/saved_models/rl/ (hopefx_ppo.zip). The `rl/hopefx_ppo.zip` key in ml/saved_models/model_checksums.json was never one of those — it is a nested key nothing looks up, correct and inert — and it is left in place because `scripts/correction_register.py --id A8` counts that file's entries. UNGATED LOADERS: ten modules were routed through `ml.__init__._verify_checksum` on 2026-09-18 — advanced_ai, explainability, inference_engine, live_inference, models/base, pipeline, regime, regime_conditional, rl_agent and robust_predictor — each with a test in tests/unit/test_model_loaders_reach_the_integrity_gate.py that corrupts a real artifact and asserts the load is refused, and all of them red against the pre-fix tree. The corruption appends one byte, which a pickle ignores, so the file still loads and only the gate can refuse it. The two that remain both load through keras `load_model`, which takes a DIRECTORY in SavedModel format as readily as a file — a single sha256 does not describe it — and tensorflow is not installed here, so the gate could not be watched fire and was not claimed. What this refuses is the THIRD ungated loader and the FIRST new unlisted artifact. It deliberately does NOT block on artifact identity: whether to regenerate a manifest, restore bytes or investigate is an owner decision (MASTER_OUTSTANDING A7/A8), and all 17 artifacts currently match.
